title: Saawan Tu Mera
prompt: Hindi lo-fi indie-fusion with mellow tabla groove, soft bansuri, warm harmonium and round sub bass over dusty tape-textured pads, nostalgic and bittersweet, intimate bedroom production with subtle vinyl crackle, tender breathy male vocals close-miked, warm vintage timbre
lyrics:
[Intro]
(barishon ki yaad)
dheere dheere shaam dhale

[Verse]
khidki pe boondein gire
purani baatein yaad aaye
chai ki bhaap mein khoye
tere chehre ko main paaye

[Pre-Chorus]
[building energy]
har pal thehra sa lage
waqt yahin ruk jaaye

[Chorus]
saawan tu mera, main teri ghata
bheegi si raaton mein tu hi mila
saawan tu mera, main teri ghata
yaadon ki khushboo dil mein basa

[Verse 2]
purani chitthi padhi
tere lafzon mein kho gaya
woh galiyan ab bhi wahi
par main thoda badal gaya

[Bridge]
[melancholic]
chhup chhup ke baadal roye
meri in aankhon ki tarah
beet gaya jo woh pal
laut aaye phir DOBARA

[Flute Interlude]

[Outro]
(dheere dheere)
saawan tu mera
(main teri ghata)
